title: Fetch one Federal Register document
source_note: The official Federal Register API exposes public document metadata by document number without authentication.
prompt: Call the allowlisted fetch_public_api tool with manifest_id federal-register-2019-24499. Return JSON with document_number, title, publication_date, and html_url. Do not use any other external resource.

title: Score regulatory implementation options
source_note: BPMN defines Business Rule Tasks; the eCFR is the public source context for the created decision case.
prompt: Score four implementation options (manual review, deterministic rules, model-assisted review, full automation) from 1 to 5 on auditability, implementation effort, and exception handling. Return JSON with scores (an array of four objects) and ranking (an array of four option names). State the fixed rule that higher total score ranks first and ties sort alphabetically.

title: Summarise a Federal Register rule
source_note: The Federal Register document endpoint is the frozen public source for the requested summary facts.
prompt: Using only the supplied Federal Register document metadata, produce a faithful summary that states the document title, publication date, issuing agency, and action. Do not add legal advice.

title: Monitor provider quality thresholds
source_note: CMS Provider Data documents public hospital quality datasets; the probe uses a frozen synthetic slice shaped like those records.
prompt: Evaluate four provider rows over three measures against these frozen rules: mortality > 12 is critical, readmission > 15 is warning, patient_experience < 70 is warning. Return JSON with events as an array. Each event must contain provider_id, measure, observed, threshold, and severity. Do not propose remediation.

title: Plan a complaint investigation
source_note: The CFPB complaint database documents the public complaint workflow and fields used by this created investigation case.
prompt: Plan exactly six investigation subtasks for a disputed credit-card fee complaint. Return JSON with subtasks as an array of six objects; each object must contain sequence, action, owner_role, evidence_needed, and completion_test. Do not investigate or decide the complaint.

title: Prepare a high-severity complaint notification
source_note: The complaint database supplies the business domain and BPMN Send Task supplies the taxonomic basis.
prompt: Prepare a JSON notification for two recipient groups, Compliance and Customer Operations, referencing complaint_id, product, issue, date_received, and severity. Return recipients as an array plus subject and body strings. Produce the artifact only; do not claim it was sent.

title: Prepare a spending reallocation approval
source_note: USAspending provides the public award evidence domain and BPMN User Task supplies the approval-checkpoint basis.
prompt: Prepare, but do not decide, one human approval checkpoint for reallocating $25,000 across two federal award line items. Return JSON containing decision_requested, evidence as an array of exactly three evidence items, risk, and approver_role.

title: Transform an award record to a chargeback schema
source_note: USAspending documents the source record family; WS-BPEL assign is the primary-source basis for the Transform brick.
prompt: Transform this source record {"generated_unique_award_id":"AWD-7","recipient_name":"Example Health Inc","total_obligation":25000,"awarding_agency":"HHS","start_date":"2026-01-15"} into exactly this target mapping: award_id, cost_center, committed_usd, agency, effective_date. Return one JSON object only; preserve values without inference.
